name: Competitive Local Reproduction Theory (CLRT) v1 candidate
scientific_claim: Political-security orders persist locally when organizational, coercive, informational, logistical, and institutional stocks regenerate the access and expectations required for their own continuation faster than those stocks decay or are disrupted. Movement and external support can transport or replenish capacity but are not endogenous reproduction.
required_distinctions: national manpower vs locality-specific deployable capacity
quiet by dominance vs clandestine survival vs reporting failure

primary_questions.question: What is the minimal macrostate sufficient for predicting local persistence, regeneration, control transition, and diffusion?
Are local reproduction inputs complementary, substitutable, thresholded, or bottlenecked?
Does a multitype endogenous reproduction operator predict extinction/persistence and geographic spread?
Can raw parameters collapse into a small set of dimensionless timescale/capacity ratios with stable phase boundaries?
Is COIN better represented as competitive reproduction of insurgent and state local orders?
Which results transport across cases without case-label coefficients or holdout refitting?

forbidden_shortcuts: no event-history self-excitation added merely to match clustered violence
no case/place/faction coefficient selected from holdout fit
no reporting probability tuned to repair latent process failure
no omniscient policy access to hidden state in efficacy claims
no scalar reproduction number promoted when pathway risk sets are incompatible
no synthetic success described as historical validity
no core equation change hidden inside performance work
promotion_rule: A general-theory claim requires explanatory compression, synthetic identification and falsification, structural robustness, predictive value over reduced competitors, independent construct measurement, and transport to genuinely distinct cases.
